title: Heat Pump
description: Clock-synced sidechain ducking: hold + log release
text:
Heat Pump is a clock-synced sidechain ducking envelope: on each division the CV ducks, holds briefly, then recovers with a logarithmic release. Patch CV Out to a filter or VCA; MIDI CC mirrors when Out is enabled.

Main sets release speed. Shift + fader sets depth. Button + fader picks clock division. Short tap triggers one manual duck. Long press mutes without snapping to idle. Shift + long toggles invert.

channels.jackDescription: CV Out = duck envelope; CV In modulates Depth, Release, or triggers Duck.

title: Grooves
description: Multi-genre MIDI drum grooves with feel
text: Grooves is a one-channel multi-genre drum helper with up to seven MIDI voices clock-synced in 4/4. **Groove** picks the genre family; **Density** and **Feel** shape fills and character; **Drummer** personas (long press) change ornament style. Swing depth is capped by **Swing max %** (sign = direction). Jack modes include Any/Stacked CV out and CV in for Density, Feel, or Reset. Clock-driven scheduling stays in a dedicated processor; MIDI sends run in a separate task (`pending_*` isolation).

channels.jackDescription: Any: velocity-weighted pulse per hit. Stacked: 1 V kick, 2 V snare, 4 V hats.
channels.faderDescription: Reveals extra drum hits as ghosts.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse swing. Long: Any vs Stacked.

title: Semmy
text:
CV in, filtered CV out. A Chamberlin state-variable filter runs at 1 kHz with cutoff roughly 0.1–200 Hz and four modes: LP, HP, BP and Notch. Main faders are always Cutoff and Q; Shift layers switch between output offset/attenverter while CV is active and LFO speed/attenverter while the internal morph LFO runs. Btn0 hold on ch0 scrubs morph in LFO mode; Btn1 hold on ch1 scrubs dry/wet (0 = pre-filter source, full = filtered).

With no input movement for about 1.2 s the jack is treated as idle and a morphing LFO (same engine as Super LFO) feeds the filter instead — movement on the jack switches back to CV immediately. **LFO Speed** shifts the whole internal rate range to Slow or Slowest. Shift + short press on ch0 toggles clock sync while the LFO is active.

Short tap on Btn0 mutes (output parks at 0 V unipolar or mid-scale bipolar; MIDI is silenced too). Long press cycles filter mode on release; the mode is stored and synced to the configurator. LEDs split by source: CV mode colours Btn0 by filter mode; LFO mode paints Btn0 and the top LED with morph hues, with a brief mode flash after a long press. Ch1 meters the output.

Optional MIDI Out mirrors the same post-filter, post-att/offset level. **MIDI Mode** CC sends gated controller data; Note maps output across two octaves above **Base Note** (full-scale = +24 semitones). CV jacks stay CV-only.

channels.jackDescription: CV input. Set Range to 0–10 V for unipolar sources or ±5 V for bipolar. With no movement for about 1.2 s the internal morph LFO takes over.
channels.faderDescription: Main: filter cutoff. Alt while the internal LFO runs: LFO rate (or clock division when sync is on). Alt while CV is active: output offset.
channels.ledTop: Morph hue while the internal LFO runs; red offset level while Shift is held
channels.ledBottom: Red offset level while Shift is held
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: While the internal LFO runs, Btn0 hold + fader scrubs morph.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: CV: output offset after the filter. Internal LFO: morph amount on the wave (Third layer while Btn0 is held).
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes the output. Long press cycles LP → HP → BP → Notch (mode color until release).
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: While the internal LFO runs, toggles free-running vs clock-synced. The button flashes when sync engages.

channels.jackDescription: Dry/wet mix of the filter source and filtered CV, after attenuverter and offset.
channels.faderDescription: Main: filter resonance (stable, no self-oscillation). Alt: output attenuverter. Third (Btn1 hold): dry/wet (0 = pre-filter source, full = filtered).
channels.ledTop: Output level, red att while Shift, or cyan dry/wet while Btn1 is held
channels.ledBottom: Output level, or red att while Shift is held
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Btn1 hold + fader: blend dry source into filtered output.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Scales the mixed signal before the jack.
